UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user Google account details and session metadata.

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent sign-in

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when account details were synced

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Personalized configuration for roommate tracking including names, emails, and payment methods.

meName.description: Display name of the primary user

friendName.description: Display name of the roommate or friend

meEmail.description: Email address of the primary user

defaultPaymentMethod.description: Preferred payment method (e.g. Apple Cash, Venmo, Zelle)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was last updated

BudgetConfig.title: BudgetConfig
BudgetConfig.description: Spending goals, monthly allowance limit, and individual category budgets.

categoryBudgets.description: Individual monthly budget limits for each expense category

alertThresholdPercent.description: Percentage alert threshold for budget pace (e.g. 80)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when budget was last updated

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Personal or shared expense logged with category, split policy, notes, and payment info.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who logged this expense

title.description: Description or merchant name of the expense

category.description: Category key: uber, dining, groceries, housing, coffee, shopping, subscriptions, entertainment, other

date.description: ISO date string of the transaction

notes.description: Optional notes or AI receipt extraction context

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the expense was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the expense was last updated

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Real-time activity feed event capturing actions taken across devices.

id.description: Unique identifier for the activity item

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID who performed the action

action.description: Action type (e.g. logged_expense, scanned_receipt, settled, updated_budget, signed_in)

/users/{userId}/account/info.description: Google account details, avatar, and sign-in metadata.

/users/{userId}/profile/config.description: Roommate settings, personal names, emails, and payment methods.

/users/{userId}/profile/budget.description: Monthly spending budgets and individual category caps.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Personal and shared expenses with categories and split rules.

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Real-time audit log of changes and roommate settlements.
